objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Make XDebug connect back to your debugger, run PHP code on a server and read /ctf/flag.
hints: Read the xdebug section of phpinfo: remote debugging is on and the server connects back to the address that made the request.
A DBGp debugger can ask the engine to evaluate code. The flag is at /ctf/flag on each machine.

steps.title: Identify the extension
steps.prompt: Which PHP extension is enabled for remote debugging on both sites?

steps.title: Find the setting
steps.prompt: Which XDebug 2 setting makes the server connect back to the requesting client's address? (setting name)

steps.title: Trigger a session
steps.prompt: Which request parameter or cookie name starts a debugging session?

steps.title: Name the protocol
steps.prompt: Which debugging protocol does XDebug speak to the debugger? (acronym)
